function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT v.vendor_id, v.vendor_name, pl.period, SUM(pl.qty) AS total_qty
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor v ON pl.vendor_id = v.vendor_id
WHERE pl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY v.vendor_id, v.vendor_name, pl.period
ORDER BY v.vendor_name, pl.period","purpose":"Quantity by vendor and period"}
